verdicts.reason: A drops the sky-and-sea scene completely, so it no longer looks like the original. The CTA and the 40% badge are tiny and squeezed into the middle, where the oversized headline overpowers them. The right-hand body copy wraps into five ragged lines, and the logo is not aligned with the headline. B keeps the scene but has worse defects. The Meridian logo sticks out past the panel edge and sits on the busy sea and hills, colliding with the panel. The 40% badge is squashed into an ellipse with very small text, and the panel is clipped at the top and bottom of the canvas. The CTA and badge are also very small. A is less bad because it has no collisions or distortion.
